mapper.insert: INSERT INTO accommodation_info (destination_id, checkin_time, checkout_time, room_count, room_type, star_rating, breakfast_included, parking_available, pet_allowed, contact_number, homepage_url, etc) VALUES (#{destinationId}, #{checkinTime}, #{checkoutTime}, #{roomCount}, #{roomType}, #{starRating}, #{breakfastIncluded}, #{parkingAvailable}, #{petAllowed}, #{contactNumber}, #{homepageUrl}, #{etc})
mapper.update: UPDATE accommodation_info SET checkin_time = #{checkinTime}, checkout_time = #{checkoutTime}, room_count = #{roomCount}, room_type = #{roomType}, star_rating = #{starRating}, breakfast_included = #{breakfastIncluded}, parking_available = #{parkingAvailable}, pet_allowed = #{petAllowed}, contact_number = #{contactNumber}, homepage_url = #{homepageUrl}, etc = #{etc} WHERE destination_id = #{destinationId}
